mapper.select: SELECT s.standings_id, s.team_id, s.position, s.played_games, s.won, s.draw, s.lost, s.points, s.goals_for, s.goals_against, s.goal_difference, s.season, s.league, t.team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.logo FROM standings s INNER JOIN team t ON s.team_id = t.team_id ORDER BY s.points DESC, s.goal_difference DESC, s.goals_for DESC;
